versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, and Install-First Success Path

Initial release of the Game Controller Charging Dock Map skill.

- Provides a printable dock layout card for organizing and labeling controller charging stations.
- Includes sections for assigned slots, cable labels, return rules, and a shared charge/reset checklist.
- Helps reduce cable clutter and mix-ups in shared or family gaming spaces.
- Limits advice to tidiness and organization; does not include electrical repair or troubleshooting.
- Offers a refusal message for repair or modification requests.
